description: Metadata for public Stimson Center research, program, and news pages about artificial intelligence and technology policy on www.stimson.org and stimson.org. Both hosts resolve. robots.txt allows those paths. HTML pages returned a Cloudflare challenge and were not stored. The challenge was not bypassed. Person profiles, donation pages, login walls, PDFs, and unrelated topics are omitted. An unresolved host, an HTML robots.txt, or a redirect off these hosts is an empty catalog. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A missing date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
